title: When Does AI for PDEs Yield Scientific Evidence?
abstract: arXiv:2608.22504v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing AI-for-PDE benchmarks primarily assess models in terms of predictive or approximation accuracy. In physics research, however, AI outputs often serve as evidence for scientific claims. These two objectives are not equivalent: the former measures an output's agreement with a reference target or satisfaction of governing constraints; the latter asks whether, given a specified object of study, scientific claim, assumptions, and evidence standard, the output provides sufficient evidence for that claim. To bridge this gap, we extend a widely used PDE-simulation benchmark and a comprehensive benchmark for PDE inverse problems to enable, for the first time in AI for PDEs, evaluation of whether and to what extent model outputs support specified scientific claims. translated_title: 人工智能用于偏微分方程何时能产生科学证据？
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22504v1 公告类型：新 摘要：现有的AI用于偏微分方程基准测试主要评估模型的预测或近似精度。然而，在物理学研究中，AI输出通常作为科学主张的证据。这两个目标并不等同：前者衡量输出与参考目标的一致性或对控制约束的满足；后者则询问，在给定的研究对象、科学主张、假设和证据标准下，输出是否为该主张提供了充分证据。为弥合这一差距，我们扩展了一个广泛使用的偏微分方程模拟基准测试和一个全面的偏微分方程逆问题基准测试，首次在AI用于偏微分方程领域，评估模型输出是否以及多大程度上支持指定的科学主张。我们的结果表明，数值精度和证据支持可能对模型排名产生不同结果，我们解释了何时以及为何如此，并揭示现有基准测试可能偏向某些方法。
tldr: 本文首次在AI用于偏微分方程领域引入科学证据评估，证明数值精度与证据支持可导致不同模型排名，并扩展基准测试以支持这一新评估维度。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces scientific evidence evaluation to AI for PDEs for the first time, showing numerical accuracy and evidential support can rank models differently, and extends benchmarks to enable this new assessment.
